'''Kerkarr''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] [[Engineer/Legends|Engineer]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]].

==Biography==
In [[3641 BBY]], he tasked a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] spacer to locate cold-resistant [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] that were damaged in a crash landing and recover their design specs from the crash site.
